summary: This bill requires the Secretary of the Interior to impose specific conditions on mineral extraction projects near urban areas or environmentally sensitive areas, including assessments of transportation, water use, and alternative transportation methods, before issuing mineral material sales contracts or free use permits.

scores.thoughts: This bill imposes new requirements on mineral extraction projects, including haul route impact assessments that consider air quality and noise, water use and conservation plans, and analysis of lower-impact transportation modes. These measures are designed to mitigate environmental impacts, indicating a move towards greater environmental protection.

The bill specifies that annual reports submitted by mineral extraction projects, including details on water consumption and truck trips, will be treated as confidential business information and exempt from FOIA, with only an aggregated summary made public. This directly addresses data privacy for businesses involved in these projects.
